# Identifier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Identifier`](gmeow-Identifier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Identifier>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified external-identifier record bundling a scheme-local value with its scheme, and optionally the authority URL that resolves it and a human-readable name — an ORCID, a geni profile id, a Nostr nip05, a LEI, a ROR ID, a NAICS code. Reification ensures that when an entity carries multiple identifiers, each value is paired with its correct scheme (and url/name) in projections. The structured sibling of [`gmeow:authorityLink`](../properties/gmeow-authorityLink.md): a flat [`authorityLink`](../properties/gmeow-authorityLink.md) points at an external record by IRI; an [`Identifier`](gmeow-Identifier.md) decomposes the scheme/value/url/name a [schema:PropertyValue](https://schema.org/PropertyValue) or DataCite relatedIdentifier carries.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify an external identifier so its scheme, value, resolving URL, and label travel together — necessary whenever an entity carries more than one code (a LEI plus a ROR plus a NAICS) and projections must pair each value with its own scheme.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a flat scheme-on-the-bearer property (it produces cross-product pairing bugs when several identifiers coexist) and avoid it for a plain see-also IRI (that is the flat [`gmeow:authorityLink`](../properties/gmeow-authorityLink.md)); a name borne by an entity is a [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md), not an [`Identifier`](gmeow-Identifier.md).

### How to use

- Mint one [`gmeow:Identifier`](gmeow-Identifier.md) per code, set [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](../properties/gmeow-identifierScheme.md) and [`gmeow:identifierValue`](../properties/gmeow-identifierValue.md) on it (plus [`gmeow:identifierUrl`](../properties/gmeow-identifierUrl.md) and [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) as needed), and attach it with [`gmeow:hasIdentifier`](../properties/gmeow-hasIdentifier.md) or a specialization ([`gmeow:legalIdentifier`](../properties/gmeow-legalIdentifier.md), [`gmeow:industryClassification`](../properties/gmeow-industryClassification.md)).

### Examples

- ex:acmeLei a [`gmeow:Identifier`](gmeow-Identifier.md); [`gmeow:identifierScheme`](../properties/gmeow-identifierScheme.md) "lei"; [`gmeow:identifierValue`](../properties/gmeow-identifierValue.md) "529900T8BM49AURSDO55".
